visualCharacteristics: A horizontal row of CTA buttons on a dark band, each button pairing a small icon with a text label (e.g. Enroll Now, Download App, Download Brochure). Buttons are centered and evenly spaced.
contentPattern: Columns (three columns): one row with three columns, each column containing an icon image plus a linked label.
usage: A prominent call-to-action button row placed on a solid dark section background, directly beneath a hero.
